_about: cc-P108. The one switch for the live shard. Read by scripts\Live-Switch.ps1 (Get-LiveSwitch), which the Shard Console, Deploy-StatusPublisher.ps1, Publish-PatchNotes.ps1, Publish-GamePcSnapshot.ps1 and docker\uo-status\Start-UoStatus.ps1 (the probe's SL_LIVE_ENABLED) all use.
